answer: Each name posts a decaying cedar-class bond of 2,160 POA — unsellable, no coupon — through one funding inlet, holding a non-transferable pearl as receipt. Each epoch it sheds 85 POA unless a unique 32-byte seed is signed in 28s; a timely sign rebates that shed. A second inlet, reused sign, or miss seizes 520 POA and benches the pearl 14 epochs. One honest lock is 2,160 POA; 900 idle copies park 1.944M POA and bleed 76,500 POA an epoch, vs ~150 POA farmed. Rented live names: require two seeds minutes apart; slash inlet clusters sharing payers or 3ms-apart signs.
